name: Marble
author: Erin Carter
description: Suminagashi paper-marbling: two inks from opposite ends of the palette interleave as thin luminous filaments on a near-black ground, folding into hooked swirls as a drifting domain warp perpetually stretches and refolds the sheet — ink combed on water that never settles and never resets.

params.label: Churn speed
params.effect: Scales how fast the domain-warp offsets advance — filaments fold lazily at the low end and visibly roil at the high end.

params.label: Fold
params.effect: Amplitude of the iterated domain warp — low gives gentle wavy bands, high gives tightly wound hooks and spirals.

params.label: Swirl scale
params.effect: CSS-pixel size of the dominant swirl features, from fine dense marbling to a few huge slow folds.
